capabilities: Toggle always-on-top via ribbon icon or command
Set window opacity with presets and a slider
Pin and adjust translucency for Settings and popped-out windows
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); opacity on Linux depends on the compositor; settings reset when the plugin is disabled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep its window floating on top of other apps or to make it translucent for reference while working elsewhere.
summary: Window utility that pins the Obsidian window above all other application windows and adjusts its opacity.
